page.overview:
What is Isoples?

Isopoles was one of the Kentauroi who went into a frenzy at the mere smell of the wine fellow Kentauroi Pholos was serving to Herakles when Herakles was on his journey to find the Ermanthian Boar. Isoples and the other Peloponnesioi Kentauroi (with the exception of Pholos) attacked Herakles and in the insuing fight were all but wiped out by him. It is most likely that Isopoles was among their number.

Either Seilenos & Melia or Ixion & Nephele
